response.name: Copy-number alterations
response.description: Putative focal (segment length < 10 Mb) CNAs from FACETS v0.5.14 with params cval_pre=25, cval_pro=500. Values: -2 = homozygous deletion; -1 = loss of heterozygosity; 0 = neutral / no change / not focal; 1 = low- or medium-level gain; 2 = high-level gain

response.name: Mutations
response.description: Whole exome sequencing data analyzed by Mutect2 (GATK v4.1.8.1) and annotated with VEP v104.

response.name: Fusions
response.description: Known oncogenic fusions and 'novel' fusions implicating a driver gene (see 'Fusion_Category'). Columns from each caller were prefixed by 2-letter acronyms, with AR, ES, PZ, and SF standing for Arriba, EricScript, Pizzly, and STAR-Fusion, respectively.
